title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, November 16-22
content: The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region. The ratings do not count recordings that viewers watch later.

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Universe 6 Saiyans Deserve to Return for Their Own Arc
content: What would the Saiyan race look like if it hadn’t been enslaved by Frieza and nearly exterminated? The Universe 6 Saiyans give us that alternate timeline in Dragon Ball Super , as they flourished as a peaceful nation that didn’t make its living conquering other worlds.

title: 6 Years Later, Demon Slayer Star Breaks Silence on Anime’s Most Iconic Moment Ever
content: Rengoku’s voice actor shares his thoughts on the most iconic anime moment ever. The Demon Slayer : Mugen Train film was released in Japanese theaters on October 16th, 2025, and it made history with its astounding success.

title: 3 More New Anime to Watch If You Miss 1990s Anime
content: There’s no denying that the 1990s was a revolutionary decade for the anime industry, as it introduced several iconic films and series that are still loved even now. The animation styles were distinctive, with grainy visuals that can’t be replicated today.

title: Miss Vinland Saga? New 2027 Anime Confirms Its Release Date & It’s the Next Must-Watch
content: One of the most anticipated anime of 2027 confirmed its release date in a brand new trailer. Since fans of Vinland Saga fans still have no idea when to expect the anime’s third season, this upcoming historical anime will be perfect for fans to watch in the meantime.

title: New Live-Action Hana-Kimi Series Unveils More Cast, New Trailer
content: The staff for the new live-action television series based on the late Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) unveiled four more cast members and a new 30-second trailer on Saturday.

title: Dragon Ball Super Secretly Has a King of the Saiyans It Hasn’t Even Used Yet
content: A major aspect that’s yet to get explored in the Dragon Ball multiverse is the only living king of the Saiyans, Universe 6’s Sadala. The Tournament of Power revealed to the Z Fighters that there is an existing Saiyan planet. Goku and Vegeta lost their home world in Universe 7 when Frieza destroyed Planet Vegeta .

title: Precure Franchise Announces FUNtasic Precure! Anime
content: Toei Animation announced on Thursday that the 24th entry in the Precure franchise has the title FUNtasic Precure! The tagline for the anime is "Shine! Everyone's smiles! Welcome to the FUNtasic party!" The logo features party motifs such as confetti poppers and garlands.
